universal_lens: Shot quality decomposes into spatial positioning and execution efficacy; EFG isolates value, ESQ isolates environment, EFG+ isolates skill. Shot quality quantified via EFG, ESQ, and EFG+; offense-defense duality mapped through team performance clusters.
